title: Count keys with the entry API
summary: Accumulate repeated words without overwriting earlier counts, borrow lookup keys and avoid depending on hash iteration order.

import.clue: Keyword bringing the standard map type into scope

binding.clue: Modifier allowing entry updates and key removal

tokens.clue: String-slice method yielding words separated by Unicode whitespace

entry.clue: Map method selecting an occupied or vacant position for a word key

default.clue: Entry method inserting zero only when the key is absent and yielding an exclusive value reference

dereference.clue: Operator accessing the u32 through the exclusive count reference

equal.clue: Macro checking the accumulated red count

lookup.clue: Map method returning an optional shared reference for a borrowed key
